원문: Decent umbrella, but customer service is outstanding! - UPDATED. I like to write my reviews well after having owned the product long enough to have an educated opinion of the product. We have had this umbrella for a year now. Early on it worked exactly as we wanted. But as mentioned by a few folks in previous reviews, you don't want to have it up in strong winds. We went to use it this summer and found that the main horizontal pole that attaches to the top of the umbrella spire had a plastic connector break. It is the main part that connects the umbrella to the horizontal extension pole, AND is responsible for the majority of the horizontal stability of the umbrella. I am quite surprised this part was made of plastic. While we did not try to use it in winds at all, I believe that over the course of time, and with normal breezes, this part just weakened and eventually broke. The only other knock on the product is that the dark blue canvas lost a LOT of its color and faded. You can tell from parts that are not exposed to the sun vs. those parts that are. Vast difference in color. These are the only negatives that we had for the umbrella.

원문: This shirt doesn’t do your figure any favors- it just hangs off your body. I own a different long sleeve Levi’s Jean shirt, and I love it. So I was hoping to find one that was the same or similar, but in a different Jean color. Well I tried on this shirt and immediately hated how it looked on me, as I suddenly looked ten pounds heavier. I’m 5’2, 140lbs, and a 34C bra size. And even though I ordered this in a small, the sides of the shirt seemed to go straight down, instead of going inwards by your waist to give you a slimming look. But if you prefer a button down shirt that’s shaped like that, I’d recommend going to the thrift store instead, as I’m sure you could find a Jean shirt there that fits the exact same, except it would be a few dollars, instead of the ludicrous number Levi’s is charging.

원문: Uneven Sizing.... I ordered this set in Navy Blue, size Small. I'm 5'4" and 113 lbs. The top fits great. The straps are adjustable and the fabric is soft. The bottoms are way too tight around the waist, though. You would have to be 100 lbs or less for the bottoms to fit comfortably and not have the elastic dig in. Seeing as how this set is made in China, it wouldn't surprise me if these are Asian sizes, which are significantly smaller than US/UK. I probably would have done well with a Small top and a Medium bottom, but since you can't mix and match, I can only wear half of this set. I'll be donating this to my local thrift store since I can't return it, and I advise anyone interested in this to be mindful of the sizing.
